explanation: Treponema pallidum is the causative agent of syphilis, presenting characteristically with a painless firm ulcer called a chancre during the primary stage. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T1#GNS216_U5_T1_h2)

question: Which clinical observation is characteristic of central cyanosis?

options.A: Flushed, red cheeks during a febrile episode
options.B: Pale and cool fingertips exposed to cold air
options.C: Bluish discoloration of the tongue and oral mucosa
options.D: Yellowish tint in the sclera of the eyes

explanation: Central cyanosis affects core mucous membranes like the tongue, reflecting generalized arterial oxygen desaturation. [learn more](GNS213_U2_T10#GNS213_U2_T10_h5)

question: What is the primary operational advantage of using an incinerator for healthcare waste disposal?

options.A: Elimination of all water consumption needs
options.B: Significant reduction in total waste volume
options.C: Complete recycling of plastic syringe barrels
options.D: Conversion of biohazard ash into fertile soil

explanation: Incineration destroys combustible matter and reduces the bulk volume of waste by up to 90%, leaving a small fraction of residual ash. [learn more](GNS122_U5_T5#GNS122_U5_T5_h5)

question: What is the primary purpose of placing puncture-resistant safety boxes directly at the point of care?

options.A: To comply with fire safety regulations in hospital wards
options.B: To allow patients to dispose of their own medications
options.C: To prevent healthcare workers from walking long distances with exposed sharps
options.D: To reduce the financial cost of purchasing plastic bins

explanation: Carrying used needles across rooms increases the window of opportunity for accidental stumbles and needlestick injuries. [learn more](GNS122_U3_T5#GNS122_U3_T5_h5)

question: Which professional is primarily responsible for assessing and treating swallowing disorders in neurorehabilitation?

options.A: Occupational therapist
options.B: Speech-language pathologist
options.C: Physiotherapist
options.D: Medical social worker

explanation: Speech-language pathologists specialize in evaluating and managing both communication deficits and swallowing disorders such as dysphagia. [learn more](GNS222_U3_T22#GNS222_U3_T22_h2)

question: What is an essential nursing action during patient assessment to combat self-medication?

options.A: Instructing patients to double their medication doses if symptoms persist
options.B: Screening patients for recent over-the-counter drug and herbal product intake
options.C: Confiscating all home remedies found within a fifty-mile radius
options.D: Prescribing alternative herbal remedies to replace hospital drugs

explanation: Active screening helps identify hidden drug interactions, toxicity risks, and masked symptoms early. [learn more](GNS215_U4_T4#GNS215_U4_T4_h8)

question: What is the medical term for painful menstrual cramps of uterine origin?

options.A: Amenorrhoea
options.B: Menorrhagia
options.C: Dysmenorrhoea
options.D: Metrorrhagia

explanation: Dysmenorrhoea specifically denotes painful menstruation that originates in the uterus. [learn more](GNS216_U2_T6#GNS216_U2_T6_h1)

question: Which glial cell type is responsible for forming myelin sheaths around axons in the peripheral nervous system?

options.A: Microglial cells
options.B: Schwann cells
options.C: Astrocytes
options.D: Oligodendrocytes

explanation: Schwann cells wrap around peripheral nerve fibers to create the myelin sheath, whereas oligodendrocytes perform this function in the central nervous system. [learn more](GNS222_U3_T1#GNS222_U3_T1_h5)

question: At what point should a clinical sharps container be securely closed and replaced?

options.A: After every single patient injection procedure is finished
options.B: Only at the official end of each nursing shift rotation
options.C: When the outside container surface appears dusty or stained
options.D: When the contents reach the designated fill line indicator

explanation: Overfilling sharps containers crowds the opening and exposes personnel handling the waste to protruding needles. [learn more](GNS122_U2_T3#GNS122_U2_T3_h5)
